title: Sodium Optimization
description: ​A lightweight, performance focused Fabric modpack designed to deliver maximum frame stability
body:
![Sodium Optimization](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ef5ddc647a18d377c87abdac295e1e19a959913.png) # Sodium Optimization
A lightweight, performance-focused Fabric modpack engineered to deliver stunning visuals, seamless textures, and essential quality-of-life upgrades, all carefully configured to ensure maximum performance Whether you are playing on a budget laptop or a high-end desktop, **Sodium Optimization** provides the necessary framework to minimize lag and enhance overall responsiveness. ![Simpler line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a7712b389435ba455a74c05ac55cd81252e4f7fa.png) ## Key Features * Engineered to deliver stunning visuals, seamless textures, and essential quality-of-life upgrades, all carefully configured to ensure maximum performance. * **Maximum Performance** – Optimization mods to push your frame rates to their peak while maintaining stability. * **Input Optimization** – Fine-tuned settings to minimize input lag, ensuring smoother movement and combat. * **Authentic Experience** – Enhances game performance without changing vanilla mechanics, ensuring the feel remains exactly as intended. * **Universal Compatibility** – Fully compatible with the latest Minecraft versions and natively supports: * Windows and Linux (Debian-based) * Modrinth App, Prism Launcher, and ATLauncher ![Simpler line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a7712b389435ba455a74c05ac55cd81252e4f7fa.png) ## Installation Guide Deploying the modpack is simple using any modern launcher that supports Modrinth modpacks: 1. Open your preferred launcher (e.g., Modrinth App, Prism, or ATLauncher). 2. Navigate to the "Modpacks" or "Browse" section. 3. Search for **Sodium Optimization**. 4. Click **Install** and launch the game. ![Simpler line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a7712b389435ba455a74c05ac55cd81252e4f7fa.png) ## Frequently Asked Questions #### 1. Will this modpack work on low-end hardware? Yes. **Sodium Optimization** is designed to be lightweight, making it an excellent choice for lower-end systems while providing stability improvements for high-end PCs. #### 2. Can I add my own mods? Yes, you are free to add additional Fabric-compatible mods to customize your experience as you see fit. #### 3. Is this pack compatible with multiplayer servers? Yes. As the included mods are client-side optimizations, you can use this pack on any vanilla or modded server without compatibility issues.
